description:
What we left behind

(Previously known as more planetary conditions)

The domain's fall echoed into history, an event never forgotten. It is up to us - the explorers, the scholars, the historians - to pick up the pieces, and harness the power we once lost.

What we lost, and what we left behind.

About

This mod focuses on exploration and colony content, with a particular incline towards cosmic horror and esoteric nonsense.

Various terrifying secrets exist in the reaches of the sector, waiting for you to discover them.

A particular focus is inter-connectedness with the world:

Most WWLB content is reacted to by the world.

Examples of WWLB content:

Spoiler

Defense satellites that interrupt battles nearby the planet and provide long-ranged fire supportA new terrain type: Meson field, that either increases sensor profile or sensor range based on your position within itA condition that spawns fleets that escort trade vessels - irritating pirates sector-wideA new objective type that can spawn in black hole / neutron star systems that vastly inhibit the negative effects of those terrainsAn overgrown nanoforge that can produce ungodly amounts of resources, but must be mainted through custom UIA terrifying secret lost in the abyss - caring not for your fleet, only persisting in it's cosmic inevitability

And far more.

[close]

Media

Gallery:

https://imgur.com/a/more-planetary-conditions-gallery-bxGugFX

Compatibility

Can be added to an existing save, but only the exploration content will generate. Run niko_MPC_genSpecialContent if adding to an existing save

DEFINITELY not safe to remove from a existing save.

FAQ

Vanilla spoilers inside

How do I trigger the content of this mod?

The only quest in this mod is triggered if you 1. Are post-galatia, 2. Have a wormhole scanner, 3. Are level 14 or higher, 4. Have not enraged kanta, 5. And go to a pirate bar.

[close]
